actual: Step 1 Partial: entering only 12 sessions and pressing Next gave 'Fix 3 things before you continue.' — 'Enter 15 to 300 minutes.' (session length), 'Enter the minimum class size.', 'Enter the maximum class size.' — but NO 'Choose whether the waitlist is on.' error; the waitlist switch left off is apparently an acceptable state, not an error. Step 2 Pass: minimum 0 gave exactly 'The class size starts at 1.' Step 3 FAIL: minimum 8 and maximum 6 gave NO range error — the only error was 'Fix 1 thing before you continue.' / 'Enter 15 to 300 minutes.' The maximum-can't-be-lower-than-the-minimum check (naming 8) did not fire while the session length was empty (it may be masked by the missing-length error, not absent — re-test with length filled is planned). Step 4 Pass: 6 to 12, 60 minutes, waitlist on saved and advanced to Step 4 of 5: Curriculum ('3 of 5 steps done', 60%, 'Draft saved 6:26 pm', Sessions 'Done'), showing 12 sessions to title. The program was not created, so the expectation that 'new classes start from 6 to 12 and 60 minutes' was not verified (it would require creating a class).
expected: Missing fields show 'Enter the minimum class size.', 'Enter the maximum class size.' and 'Choose whether the waitlist is on.' 0 shows 'The class size starts at 1.' 8 to 6 is refused because the maximum can't be lower than the minimum (names 8). The valid set saves and new classes start from 6 to 12 and 60 minutes.
steps: Enter only 12 sessions and press Next.
Enter minimum 8 and maximum 6, press Next.
Enter 6 to 12, a length of 60 minutes, choose waitlist on, press Next.
